entries.title: Psalms 94:1
segments: ¶O God, in whose hands is punishment, O God of punishment, let your shining face be seen.

entries.title: Psalms 94:2
segments: Be lifted up, O judge of the earth; let their reward come to the men of pride.

entries.title: Psalms 94:3
segments: How long will sinners, O Lord, how long will sinners have joy over us?

entries.title: Psalms 94:4
segments: Words of pride come from their lips; all the workers of evil say great things of themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 94:5
segments: Your people are crushed by them, O Lord, your heritage is troubled,

entries.title: Psalms 94:6
segments: They put to death the widow and the guest, they take the lives of children who have no father;

entries.title: Psalms 94:7
segments: And they say, Jah will not see it, the God of Jacob will not give thought to it.

entries.title: Psalms 94:8
segments: Give your mind to my words, you who are without wisdom among the people; you foolish men, when will you be wise?

entries.title: Psalms 94:9
segments: Has he by whom your ears were planted no hearing? or is he blind by whom your eyes were formed?

entries.title: Psalms 94:10
segments: He who is the judge of the nations, will he not give men the reward of their acts, even he who gives knowledge to man?

entries.title: Psalms 94:11
segments: The Lord has knowledge of the thoughts of man, for they are only a breath.

entries.title: Psalms 94:12
segments: ¶Happy is the man who is guided by you, O Jah, and to whom you give teaching out of your law;

entries.title: Psalms 94:13
segments: So that you may give him rest from the days of evil, till a hole is made ready for the destruction of the sinners.

entries.title: Psalms 94:14
segments: The Lord will not give up his people, or take away his support from his heritage;

entries.title: Psalms 94:15
segments: But decisions will again be made in righteousness; and they will be kept by all whose hearts are true.

entries.title: Psalms 94:16
segments: Who will give me help against the sinners? and who will be my support against the workers of evil?

entries.title: Psalms 94:17
segments: If the Lord had not been my helper, my soul would quickly have gone down into death.

entries.title: Psalms 94:18
segments: If I say, My foot is slipping; your mercy, O Lord, is my support.

entries.title: Psalms 94:19
segments: Among all my troubled thoughts, your comforts are the delight of my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 94:20
segments: What part with you has the seat of sin, which makes evil into a law?

entries.title: Psalms 94:21
segments: They are banded together against the soul of the upright, to give decisions against those who have done no wrong.

entries.title: Psalms 94:22
segments: But the Lord is my safe resting-place; my God is the Rock where I am safe.

entries.title: Psalms 94:23
segments: And he has made their evil designs come back on themselves, cutting them off in their sin; the Lord our God will put an end to them.
